definitions.ask: Also fix the block-ID prompt so id-less tasks link after the prompt instead of refusing as stale?
definitions.why: Same commit path; without it Linked from never links on a task with no ^id

choices.label: Id-less tasks link after one prompt, in both Links to and Linked from
Direction-only fix; id-less tasks get an ^id, then still refuse "changed — reopen"

definitions.ask: Should Linked-from success toasts name the task whose LINKS line changed?
definitions.why: The current wording names the card's own task and reads like the reversed edge

choices.label: Toasts read “Other” now links here, Relabeled “Other”, and Unlinked “Other”
Toasts keep naming the card's own task, e.g. “Current” now links here
